title: config paths
description: Where the design's definitions file is, from config --paths, so a person or a script can open it; the CLI's own answer on the machine it runs on, which the board does not ask over HTTP.

apiVersion.description: Always elderlygate/designer/app/v1: the form of e-designer's answers. An app's answers keep the family app (apiversion/v1/forms.yaml), apart from the files they describe.

kind.description: Always ConfigPaths, the kind of this answer, so a reader knows which schema its data meets.

ran.description: Where the answer came from; this contract fixes the app and the contract version, so an answer from anything else fails here.

app.description: Always designer, e-designer's product ID, since only e-designer gives this answer.

contract.description: Always v1, the contract version this schema belongs to.

data.description: The design's definitions file, as a path on the machine the CLI ran on; empty when no design was read.

items.description: One path, absolute, so a terminal can open it from anywhere.
